name: Conf42 family media kit
usage: Every file: items[].url. Filter by brand, group (Logos, Colours, Social, Avatars, Stickers, Mascots, Artwork, Press), variant (color, black, white) and fmt (svg, png, pdf, eps, ...).

brands.name: Conf42
brands.about: Conf42 is where it started, online, in 2020: 30+ online conferences a year on everything from SRE and Kubernetes to Python, Rust and AI. Every talk is free on YouTube, with transcripts and slides at conf42.com.

brands.name: SREday
brands.about: SREday is where Site Reliability Engineers, DevOps practitioners and cloud architects meet face to face: talks from people running production at scale, hosted in the offices of companies like Harness, ING and Google.
brands.spelling: SREday (SRE in capitals, day in lower case)
brands.tagline:
SRE, DevOps & platform
engineering, in person

palette.name: Plum
palette.used: stats band, social buttons, home glow

brands.name: LLMday
brands.about: LLMday brings AI engineers, ML engineers and data scientists together in person to share what actually works with LLMs and agents in production: evaluation, RAG, guardrails, cost and everything in between.
brands.spelling: LLMday (LLM in capitals, day in lower case)

brands.name: PLATFORMday
brands.about: PLATFORMday is for the people who build and run internal platforms: developer experience, infrastructure, golden paths and the tooling that ties them together, in person.
brands.spelling: PLATFORMday (PLATFORM in capitals, day in lower case)

brands.name: Prompt Engineering Conference
brands.about: The Prompt Engineering Conference grew from its online beginnings in 2023 to a full day in London, co-located with LLMday London: the craft of prompting, agents and AI-assisted work.
brands.tagline:
The craft of prompting,
agents & AI

palette.name: Violet
palette.used: stats band, buttons, home glow; the logo

brands.name: Reliaburger
brands.about: Reliaburger is a container orchestrator in Rust by Miko Pawlikowski: one binary, a complete container platform, zero assembly. Source, design notes and a free book on GitHub.
brands.tagline:
One binary. A complete
container platform.

brands.name: CFP Ninja
brands.about: CFP Ninja is the open Call for Papers platform every Conf42, SREday and LLMday CFP runs on. Speakers find open calls and submit once; organisers review in one place.

brands.name: Certified FYI
brands.about: Certified FYI issues verifiable certificates of achievement: organisers issue them, speakers collect them on a public profile.

brands.name: Badger
brands.about: Badger prints attendee badges at the door of every SREday, LLMday and PLATFORMday; Snout by Badger is its sponsor lead scanner.
brands.spelling: Badger (Snout by Badger for the lead scanner)
brands.tagline:
Event badges,
printed at the door
